mostWorthwhile.text: Completing the eye fittings was most worthwhile: the planned ray diagram connects the cornea, pupil, lens and retina into one light path.

leastWorthwhile.text: The successive fittings were clear but predictable, with little decision-making once the slots were named.

surprise.text: The explicit contrast between incoming light and outgoing nerve signals sharpened the distinction between the image and the signal sent to the brain.

continue.text: I would choose to continue for another chapter if it offered similarly clear connections between structure and function, though I would hope for more meaningful choices than the straightforward fittings here.
